properties.title: Kaunas / Kovno · anti-Jewish pogrom begins
properties.note: Anti-Jewish violence escalated under German occupation. The museum account dates the Slobodka pogrom to 25–26 June. This snapshot marks its beginning; it does not project the full two-day outcome backwards onto 25 June.

properties.title: Białystok · 27 June murder of Jewish residents
properties.note: The USHMM family record identifies German Police Battalion 309’s murder of Jewish residents on 27 June, including people locked inside the Great Synagogue and burned alive. This is the preceding day’s civilian context for the 28 June military snapshot. No aggregate victim total is assigned to the marker.
properties.name: Białystok · 27 June murder of Jewish residents

properties.title: Iași · pogrom and deportation context
properties.actor: Romanian authorities, military and police; German participation
properties.note: The commission describes late-June mass violence against Jews in Iași, involving Romanian state institutions and German participants, followed by lethal deportation trains. This is retrospective context for the 3 July Prut operations. The city marker supplies no invented train route or combined victim total.
